# 1D-CNN hybrid

**Rank 5 of 22** by test score · Hybrid multi-task · runs on the STM32H573 · [← all models](../../README.md#all-models)

<picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../../assets/viz/rows/21-dark.svg"><img src="../../assets/viz/rows/21-light.svg" alt="1D-CNN hybrid result"></picture>

| Test score | CV macro F1 | Fault detection | False alarms | Class accuracy | Inference (STM32H573) | Flash | RAM | MACC | Training time |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 96.5% | 94.9% | 95.2% | 2.2% | 97.6% | 18.170 ms | 125.75 KiB | 56.39 KiB | 464,417 | 171.0 s |

<sub>Test score = balanced accuracy of fault vs. no-fault on 7 unseen test recordings (mean of fault detection rate and 1 − false alarm rate).</sub>

**Model:** Two residual Conv1D encoders plus a context branch, three heads

> Catches the early mechanical fault best in the live test; the slowest model (18.2 ms).
